traces.question: Panel F6d shows Cu K-edge EXAFS Fourier-transform spectra for the La2CuO4 nanobamboos, nanorods and bulk sample, plotted alongside Cu2O, CuO and Cu-foil references. What peak positions appear in common across the three La2CuO4 sample traces, and how do they compare in that region to the Cu-foil reference trace?

traces.question: The claim under test is that CO-related intermediates bind more strongly on La2CuO4 NBs and NRs than on bulk La2CuO4. Does the CO TPD panel (F6b) support this ranking?
traces.answer_key: No. The three CO desorption peaks (for NBs, NRs, and bulk) differ by only 9 C, while each peak is roughly 100 C wide, so the ranking of CO binding strength implied by the claim sits at the resolution of the measurement and cannot be read off the panel.

traces.question: The claim under test is that bulk La2CuO4 gives a Faradaic efficiency for CO of 91% at -1.0 V vs RHE and produces no C2H4 at any potential. Does the stacked-bar panel F5c support this claim?
traces.answer_key: No. In panel F5c the bulk stacked FE bars total about 103-105% at -1.2, -1.1, -1.0 and -0.9 V vs RHE, above the 100% ceiling, so the panel cannot be read as cleanly confirming the claimed values.
